Ganesha Ne Muush Par Baap Ko Haraaya! 🏆

🔱 Ganesha Kartikeya race around the world parents wisdom

A race was declared between Ganesha and Kartikeya: whoever circumambulates the entire universe first wins. Kartikeya flew on his peacock. Ganesha simply circled his parents Shiva and Parvati, saying 'My entire universe is in you.' The sages declared Ganesha the winner — wisdom over speed.
